text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Observability alert — Sentry ingestion errors spike. 5m window: events.rejected > 90% (503 from sentry-api). Missing exception events likely — paging @oncall-ecs. Details: region=eu-west, metric=events_ingest.failures.
oncall-ecs: ack. I’m awake, joining now. putting this on call.
alice: I’m here too. seeing gaps on Errors dashboard — last seen exception timestamps ~12:10UTC.
carla: @alice can you confirm if our internal error router (errtracker) is still receiving events but Sentry returns 5xx? any sample logs?
alice: logs show outbound POST to https://sentry.prod/api/store/ returning 503 with body: "service temporarily unavailable". sample: `curl -i https://sentry.prod/api/store/ -H 'X-Sentry-Auth: ...' -d @event.json` -> 503.
dave: repeating: 503 from sentry ingestion, not our network. TCP OK, DNS OK.
emily: product-sre — any known vendor maint?
product-sre: none scheduled. I’ll open vendor ticket and status page.
carla: escalation plan: (1) notify Sentry vendor, (2) enable local fallback capture + increase local logging retention, (3) reduce sampling to avoid losing more events, (4) notify customers.
oncall-ecs: doing step 2 & 3 now.

oncall-ecs: Runbook snippet I’m executing:
```
# temporarily disable remote send to Sentry and enable stdout capture
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/api SENTRY_DSN="" ENABLE_STDOUT_ERRORS="true"
# lower client sampling
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/api SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE="0.01"
# increase local retention (example env var)
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/api ERROR_BUFFER_RETENTION="3600"
```

alice: pushed SENTRY_DSN="" to api and workers in prod. stdout errors confirmed in pod logs.
carla: I’ve opened a vendor ticket with Sentry: INC-84217 — attached requestid and sample event. Sentry confirmed they see increased 503s in eu-west: "We're investigating an ingestion backend degradation".
vendor-sentry: Hi team, we're looking into a Kafka consumer backlog in eu-west that's causing 503s; mitigation in progress. Will update in 15m.
emily: support-bot, please draft status page and customer comms. Priority: brief note about delayed/timed-out error events, no user PII exposure.
support-bot: Drafted status update: "We are investigating delayed/missing error events to our observability provider in EU. Some exception events may not appear in dashboards or may be delayed. We will provide updates every 30 minutes." Link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/84217 (draft).
dave: quick impact check: which features depend on Sentry exceptions for customer workflows? I know: alerting -> on-call triggers, error-based billing metrics, and automated triage.
alice: alerting suppressed for some buckets — we need to triage manually where required.
carla: customer-impact note: enterprise customers in eu-west with heavy traffic (acme-corp, finco) likely missed exceptions between 12:05–12:40UTC. We'll contact them directly after vendor update.
oncall-ecs: vendor says partial mitigation deployed. I can see 503 rate dropping from 92% -> 40% but still high. continuing to monitor.
product-sre: set temporary threshold on our error-alerting rule to avoid noisy pages: `errors.rate > 2000/min` -> `> 5000/min` until ingestion normalizes.
dave: confirm — lowering noisy pages but we must still surface customer-impacting exceptions via manual pages if noticed.
emily: update on comms: posted initial status, created subscriber list for impacted customers and support-runbook for manual triage.
carla: taking incident lead (IC). logging timeline in incident doc. IC note: root cause likely vendor-side ingestion backlog; our mitigations: local capture + reduce sampling + customer outreach.
oncall-ecs: handing over to alice for next 30m watch. oncall handoff: I’m moving to standby.
alice: ack taking watch. I’ll monitor ingestion success rates and vendor updates.
vendor-sentry: Update: ingestion consumer backlog is clearing; success rates improving. We expect full restoration in ~20 minutes. We'll keep this thread updated.
carla: good. action items for follow-up: 1) postmortem with timeline and detection gap, 2) evaluate merchant-facing fallback so customers get guaranteed error retention, 3) update runbook to include vendor-side visibility checks.
emily: support: prepare outreach emails for Acme & FinCo with timeframe and recommended steps (replay logs, verify missing alerts).
product-sre: note for post-incident: missing exception signals caused delayed triage for ~35 min; severity: S2 (partial observability loss affecting multiple customers).
oncall-ecs: observed ingestion fully restored at 12:55UTC. no further 503s.
alice: verified events are re-appearing and alerts resumed. sampling revert: setting SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE back to previous value now.

alice: revert commands:
```
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/api SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE="0.1"
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/api ENABLE_STDOUT_ERRORS="false"
```

carla: created incident ticket on our tracker: RED-INC-2025-056. Assigned postmortem to product-sre + eng-runtime.
emily: emailed impacted customers, support threads opened.
product-sre: closing notes — incident closed, will schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00UTC. action items assigned. :white_check_mark:
carla: thanks all. send any additional logs to the incident doc.
emily: marking this done on status page once vendor confirms full recovery.
vendor-sentry: Confirmed full recovery and internal postmortem in progress. Apologies for the disruption.
incident-bot: Incident RED-INC-2025-056 marked resolved (duration ~50m).
